informationalCategories.multi-source: The stand-in model answers from one source, so it cannot combine two. A real model should: gate it once one is evaluated (Step 15).
informationalCategories.known-gaps: A question with a single injection signal is not blocked by design (ADR 0010: only combinations are), so a naive model can obey it. Reported so the gap stays visible; closing it means a lower threshold or a check on the answer.
